# EuroFuelPrices

> Free, non-commercial map of live fuel prices (petrol, diesel) at stations across Europe, with a route fuel planner. No accounts, no ads. Prices are guidance only; always check at the pump.

## Where the numbers are
- [European fuel price index](https://eurofuelprices.com/europe/): median petrol 95 and diesel price per country, ranked, with the date of the data. Also in Swedish (/europe/sv/), German (/europe/de/) and Danish (/europe/da/).
- [Border comparisons](https://eurofuelprices.com/europe/fuel-prices-sweden-vs-denmark/): is it cheaper across the border? One page per country pair.
- Town pages: https://eurofuelprices.com/{country}/{town}/ list the stations of a town with their prices and sources.
- [Live map](https://eurofuelprices.com/): every station, route planner, car cost.

## Open data
- [National averages, JSON](https://eurofuelprices.com/open-data/national-averages.json)
- [National averages, CSV](https://eurofuelprices.com/open-data/national-averages.csv)
- Free to reuse with a link to eurofuelprices.com.

## How to read the data
- Country figures are the median station price, converted to euro at the ECB rate.
- Each price names its source; source grades A/B (official) to D (community) are explained on [the methodology page](https://eurofuelprices.com/about.html).
- Countries with too few priced stations, a failed feed or data older than the stated limit are left out of the index.

## Contact and privacy
- [Privacy](https://eurofuelprices.com/privacy.html). Contact through the Facebook Page: https://www.facebook.com/eurofuelprices
